## Install

1. Download **Tuck\_*_aarch64.dmg** below and open it.
2. Drag **Tuck** into **Applications**.
3. Open Tuck. The first time, macOS says it could not verify the app, because Tuck is not yet notarized by Apple. Click **Done**, then open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll to Security and click **Open Anyway** next to Tuck.

Needs macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon, with Apple Intelligence turned on (or a custom model connection in Settings). Full instructions are in the [README](https://github.com/Haffaz/tuck#install).

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists checksums for the downloads: `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt --ignore-missing`.
